The decisive mistake was at Step 2. Verification_Expert invented a "sample dataset" with made-up athlete counts, including CHN and JPN at 1 athlete each, instead of retrieving the actual 1928 Olympic participation data. The script then ran on that fabricated input, so the chosen answer (CHN) came from invented numbers. The correct answer, CUB, was never in the data. Later steps (Computer_terminal's execution and Statistics_Expert and Verification_Expert's agreement) only confirmed the fabricated result and did not catch the error.
